meta.description: Hand-compiled reference table of frequently charged offences: classification and punishment from the First Schedule of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (IPC) and of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNS), with an unofficial IPC-BNS correspondence.
sources: Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, First Schedule (indiacode.nic.in)
Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, First Schedule (indiacode.nic.in)
caveats: Not yet checked line by line against the official schedules; verify before relying on it.
State amendments can change whether an offence is cognizable or bailable.
The IPC-BNS correspondence is approximate: some provisions were split, merged or changed.

34.title: Acts done by several persons in furtherance of common intention
34.note: Not an offence by itself: each person is liable as if they did the act alone.

120B.title: Punishment of criminal conspiracy
120B.punishment: Same as abetment of the offence that was the object of the conspiracy (up to 6 months for other conspiracies)
120B.note: Classification follows the offence that was the object of the conspiracy.

147.title: Punishment for rioting
147.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both

148.title: Rioting, armed with deadly weapon
148.punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine, or both

149.title: Every member of unlawful assembly guilty of offence committed in prosecution of common object
149.note: Not an offence by itself: members share liability for the main offence.

186.title: Obstructing public servant in discharge of public functions
186.punishment: Up to 3 months, or fine up to Rs 500, or both

188.title: Disobedience to order duly promulgated by public servant
188.punishment: Up to 1 month or fine up to Rs 200; up to 6 months or fine up to Rs 1,000 if it causes danger to life, health or safety

269.title: Negligent act likely to spread infection of disease dangerous to life
269.punishment: Up to 6 months, or fine, or both

270.title: Malignant act likely to spread infection of disease dangerous to life
270.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both

271.title: Disobedience to quarantine rule
271.punishment: Up to 6 months, or fine, or both

279.title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
279.punishment: Up to 6 months, or fine up to Rs 1,000, or both

302.title: Punishment for murder
302.punishment: Death or imprisonment for life, and fine

304.title: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
304.punishment: Imprisonment for life or up to 10 years and fine (intent to kill); up to 10 years, or fine, or both (knowledge only)

304A.title: Causing death by negligence
304A.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both

304B.title: Dowry death
304B.punishment: At least 7 years, up to imprisonment for life

307.title: Attempt to murder
307.punishment: Up to 10 years and fine; up to imprisonment for life if hurt is caused

323.title: Punishment for voluntarily causing hurt
323.punishment: Up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs 1,000, or both

325.title: Punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt

326.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
326.punishment: Imprisonment for life, or up to 10 years, and fine

337.title: Causing hurt by act endangering life or personal safety of others
337.punishment: Up to 6 months, or fine up to Rs 500, or both

338.title: Causing grievous hurt by act endangering life or personal safety of others
338.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine up to Rs 1,000, or both

341.title: Punishment for wrongful restraint
341.punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 1 month, or fine up to Rs 500, or both

342.title: Punishment for wrongful confinement
342.punishment: Up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs 1,000, or both

353.title: Assault or criminal force to deter public servant from discharge of duty
353.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both

354.title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
354.punishment: At least 1 year, up to 5 years, and fine

365.title: Kidnapping or abducting with intent secretly and wrongfully to confine a person

376.title: Punishment for rape
376.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment of at least 10 years, up to imprisonment for life, and fine

379.title: Punishment for theft
379.punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine, or both

381.title: Theft by clerk or servant of property in possession of master

384.title: Punishment for extortion
384.punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine, or both

392.title: Punishment for robbery
392.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine; up to 14 years if on a highway between sunset and sunrise

395.title: Punishment for dacoity
395.punishment: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine

399.title: Making preparation to commit dacoity
399.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

402.title: Assembling for purpose of committing dacoity
402.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

406.title: Punishment for criminal breach of trust
406.punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine, or both

411.title: Dishonestly receiving stolen property
411.punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine, or both

419.title: Punishment for cheating by personation
419.punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine, or both

420.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property

427.title: Mischief causing damage to the amount of fifty rupees
427.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both

447.title: Punishment for criminal trespass
447.punishment: Up to 3 months, or fine up to Rs 500, or both

448.title: Punishment for house-trespass
448.punishment: Up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs 1,000, or both

452.title: House-trespass after preparation for hurt, assault or wrongful restraint

465.title: Punishment for forgery
465.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both

471.title: Using as genuine a forged document or electronic record
471.punishment: Same as for forging the document
471.note: Classification follows the forgery offence for that kind of document.

498A.title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
498A.note: Cognizable if the information is given by the woman, or by a relative by blood, marriage or adoption, or a notified public servant.

504.title: Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of the peace
504.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both

506.title: Punishment for criminal intimidation
506.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both; up to 7 years, or fine, or both if the threat is to cause death, grievous hurt, etc.
506.note: Basic form: bailable, any Magistrate. Threat to cause death or grievous hurt: non-bailable, Magistrate of the first class.

509.title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman
509.punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

3(5).title: Acts done by several persons in furtherance of common intention
3(5).note: Not an offence by itself: each person is liable as if they did the act alone.

61(2).title: Punishment of criminal conspiracy
61(2).punishment: Same as abetment of the offence that was the object of the conspiracy (up to 6 months for other conspiracies)
61(2).note: Classification follows the offence that was the object of the conspiracy.

64.title: Punishment for rape
64.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment of at least 10 years, up to imprisonment for life, and fine

74.title: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
74.punishment: At least 1 year, up to 5 years, and fine

79.title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman
79.punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

80.title: Dowry death
80.punishment: At least 7 years, up to imprisonment for life

85.title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
85.note: Cognizable if the information is given by the woman, or by a relative by blood, marriage or adoption, or a notified public servant.

103(1).title: Punishment for murder
103(1).punishment: Death or imprisonment for life, and fine

105.title: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
105.punishment: Imprisonment for life, or at least 5 and up to 10 years, and fine (intent to kill); up to 10 years and fine (knowledge only)

109.title: Attempt to murder
109.punishment: Up to 10 years and fine; up to imprisonment for life if hurt is caused

115(2).title: Voluntarily causing hurt
115(2).punishment: Up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs 10,000, or both

118(2).title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
118(2).punishment: Imprisonment for life, or at least 1 and up to 10 years, and fine

125(a).title: Act endangering life or personal safety of others, where hurt is caused
125(a).punishment: Up to 6 months, or fine up to Rs 5,000, or both

125(b).title: Act endangering life or personal safety of others, where grievous hurt is caused
125(b).punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine up to Rs 10,000, or both

126(2).title: Wrongful restraint
126(2).punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 1 month, or fine up to Rs 5,000, or both

127(2).title: Wrongful confinement
127(2).punishment: Up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs 5,000, or both

132.title: Assault or criminal force to deter public servant from discharge of duty
132.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both

140(3).title: Kidnapping or abducting with intent secretly and wrongfully to confine a person

190.title: Every member of unlawful assembly guilty of offence committed in prosecution of common object
190.note: Not an offence by itself: members share liability for the main offence.

191(2).title: Rioting
191(2).punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both

191(3).title: Rioting, armed with deadly weapon
191(3).punishment: Up to 5 years, or fine, or both

221.title: Obstructing public servant in discharge of public functions
221.punishment: Up to 3 months, or fine up to Rs 2,500, or both

223.title: Disobedience to order duly promulgated by public servant
223.punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 6 months or fine up to Rs 2,500; up to 1 year or fine up to Rs 5,000 if it causes danger to life, health or safety

271.title: Negligent act likely to spread infection of disease dangerous to life
271.punishment: Up to 6 months, or fine, or both

272.title: Malignant act likely to spread infection of disease dangerous to life
272.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both

273.title: Disobedience to quarantine rule

281.title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
281.punishment: Up to 6 months, or fine up to Rs 1,000, or both

303(2).title: Theft
303(2).punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine, or both; 1 to 5 years and fine on a second conviction
303(2).note: A first conviction for theft of property worth under Rs 5,000, returned or restored, may be punished with community service.

305.title: Theft in a dwelling house, or means of transportation or place of worship, etc.

306.title: Theft by clerk or servant of property in possession of master

308(2).title: Extortion

309(4).title: Robbery

310(2).title: Dacoity

310(5).punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

316(2).title: Criminal breach of trust

352.title: Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of the peace
352.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both
